title: Remaining coordinates in a true tribe
statement: Let $w,s$ be natural numbers, let $i$ be a coordinate among the $s w$ coordinates arranged in $s$ blocks of width $w$, and let $x$ be a sign assignment to those coordinates. The rest of the block containing $i$ is true at $x$ if every position in that block other than the position of $i$ has sign $-1$.
